verdict.rationale: Jina's own docs state that you can pass session cookies with the `X-Set-Cookie` header, and Reader forwards them when fetching the URL. That directly covers fetching authenticated pages with your own cookies. Support rests on a single brief documentation line. missing for 10: detailed docs on cookie format, domain scoping and how cookies interact with caching or browser rendering, and independent or hands-on confirmation that authenticated fetches work.
